_comment: ad-engine :: config/compliance-lexicon.json :: SAFETY-CRITICAL multilingual lint data for the compliance gate. THE machine source for banned-claim + personal-attribute (the 'you'+attribute trap) + restricted-category/SAC detection across en/fr/ar/ar-DZ. WHY THIS EXISTS: the prior linter was English-only, so Arabic/French/Darija ads — i.e. nearly ALL real Algeria creative — bypassed the gate entirely. This closes that hole. Consumed by skills/compliance-check/SKILL.md + agents/compliance-officer.md (G1 personal-attributes, G2 banned-claims, G4 SAC mis-declaration). Human-readable companion: playbooks/compliance-lexicon-multilang.md. Evidence: research/raw/compliance-policy.md (+ its fact-check, which overrides). SAC enum strings MUST match config/meta.json special_ad_categories.allowed_enum. THIS IS A DETECTION AID, NOT A SUBSTITUTE FOR HUMAN REVIEW — a clean lint never auto-approves; compliance-check still gates. Matching is CASE-INSENSITIVE and, for Arabic, DIACRITIC-INSENSITIVE (see matching_rules).

matching_rules._comment: How a linter MUST normalize text before matching these terms. Critical for Arabic — diacritics (tashkeel), alef/hamza variants, and tatweel cause naive substring matches to miss real violations.
matching_rules.word_boundary_preferred: Use word/token boundaries to cut false positives (e.g. EN 'cure' inside 'secure', 'manicure'; 'you' inside 'your' is intended). Multi-word phrases match as phrases.

arabic_normalization._comment: Apply ALL of these to BOTH the input text AND the lexicon terms before comparing. Algeria/Maghreb writes Arabic with Western (Latin 0-9) digits — do not digit-transliterate.
arabic_normalization.normalize_taa_marbuta: ة -> ه (match either way; do not over-normalize that breaks meaning)

darija_dual_script._comment: Algerian Darija ships in Arabic script OR Latin 'arabizi' (3=ع, 7=ح, 9=ق, 5=خ, 2=glottal). Each ar-DZ list carries both. Match arabizi case-insensitively and tolerant of the digit-letters.

matching_rules.note: personal_attribute_triggers fire ONLY on the PAIRING of a second-person pronoun within ~8 tokens of a protected-attribute term — neither alone is a block.

banned_claims._comment: G2. Absolute/guarantee/miracle/cure/get-rich/risk-free/unrealistic-timeline claims. HARD_BLOCK + return a qualified rewrite. Mirrors playbooks/compliance-redflags-dz.md §2. NOT exhaustive — a clean scan still requires human review.

personal_attribute_triggers._comment: G1, the 'you'+attribute trap. BLOCK only when a second_person pronoun co-occurs within ~8 tokens of a protected_attributes term. Catch indirect framing too (Meta upgraded the detector 2025-26). Mirrors playbooks/compliance-redflags-dz.md §1. Rewrite to product/benefit framing — never assert/imply the viewer HAS the attribute.

protected_attributes._comment: Grouped by protected class. A pronoun + ANY of these within the window = HARD_BLOCK. Classes mirror Meta's Personal Attributes policy (health, vulnerable financial status, age, body, religion/belief, relationship status, plus ethnicity/orientation/disability/criminal-voting/PII).

other_protected._comment: Ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, criminal/voting/union, and injected NAME/PII — also blocked when asserted of the viewer.

restricted_category_terms._comment: G4. Offer-type terms that, when detected, FORCE a special_ad_categories declaration (compare to the campaign's declared array — mismatch with [] = BLOCK as mis-declaration). Keyed by language, then by the EXACT SAC enum from config/meta.json special_ad_categories.allowed_enum. Reminder (fact-check): bare CREDIT is legacy/absorbed — default any loan/credit/banking/insurance/investment to FINANCIAL_PRODUCTS_SERVICES. ISSUES_ELECTIONS_POLITICS is EU-banned. crypto/pharma/alcohol/weapons need AUTHORIZATION (G3) which is separate from SAC — flagged under _authorization_only. For Algeria apparel/academy COD the correct answer is almost always [].

_authorization_only._comment: These need an authorization flag on file (G3) — NOT a SAC declaration. Detecting them with no authorization=true in the client config/spec = BLOCK. Crypto = 3-tier authorization since Mar 2026.

_notes: DETECTION AID, NOT A SUBSTITUTE FOR HUMAN REVIEW: a clean scan does NOT auto-approve. compliance-check remains the HARD gate and a human signs off before launch.
Arabic matching MUST be diacritic-insensitive and alef/yaa/tatweel-normalized (see matching_rules.arabic_normalization) — otherwise tashkeel and alef-hamza variants silently bypass the gate.

ENGLISH-ONLY WAS THE HOLE: before this file the linter only scanned English, so French/Arabic/Darija ads (≈ all real Algeria creative) passed unchecked. Always scan in the creative's declared language (config/languages.json) AND opportunistically across all four.
ONE LANGUAGE PER CREATIVE (config/languages.json one_language_per_creative): scan each creative in its single declared language; a mixed-language body is itself a quality flag.
Darija ships in Arabic script OR Latin 'arabizi' — each ar-DZ list carries both; scan both variants.
Maghreb uses WESTERN (Latin 0-9) digits even in Arabic — do not digit-transliterate during normalization.
personal_attribute_triggers fire on the PAIRING only (pronoun WITHIN ~8 tokens of an attribute); neither alone blocks. 'you/your' without a protected attribute is fine.

SAC enum strings here MUST stay in sync with config/meta.json special_ad_categories.allowed_enum. CREDIT is legacy/absorbed -> default to FINANCIAL_PRODUCTS_SERVICES. ISSUES_ELECTIONS_POLITICS is EU-banned (block EU geos).
Lists are representative, not exhaustive. Add new real-world terms here AND to playbooks/compliance-lexicon-multilang.md when discovered (POST-BUILD knowledge persistence).
